verdict.rationale: Cline supports MCP for external tool/data integrations, ACP for other clients to use Cline as a coding agent, and channel integrations (Slack, Discord, Telegram, Linear) plus CI/CD pipeline hooks, all of which let engineering leads weave third-party agent/tool ecosystems into their workflows. However, evidence is all first-party docs with no independent corroboration of actual partner-agent integrations, and no marketplace or curated partner-app directory is shown. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of third-party agent-app integrations, evidence of a partner/marketplace ecosystem beyond MCP/ACP/chat hooks.
